warnings: Recorded as pattern:'plan' per the repo's pinned rule (a structural roof-framing plan with member marks/grid refs is 'plan', never 'roof_plan', which is architectural-only) — this sheet shows ridge/purlin/rafter members with grid positions.

Interpreted as a mono-pitch (shed) roof: ridge (อกไก่เหล็ก) at the row-A end (extended 0.60m beyond A as an overhang), rafters (จันทันเหล็ก) running the full building depth from A to D, purlins (แปเหล็ก) spanning horizontally between rafters at <=0.80m centres, end closure (ปิดปลายจันทัน) at the row-D (low) end. This reading is inferred from the plan + the front-gable render on the cover page (page 1) showing a tall glazed gable wall at the front sloping down toward the back — not independently confirmed against an elevation sheet, which is outside op04 scope. If wrong, the member marks/sizes/spacing below are still correct; only the overall roof shape (mono-pitch vs. hip) would need revisiting.
Purlin quantity is spacing-governed ('@ไม่เกิน 0.80 เมตร' = at not more than 0.80m centres) rather than individually counted on the drawing — count left null, spacing recorded instead.
